title: Annihilation and completion-isomorphism transport through the thickening dictionary
statement: Let A be a Noetherian ring, I an ideal, and f:X → Spec A a finite type morphism. Put X_n = X × Spec(A/I^(n+1)), with canonical transition maps i_n:X_n → X_(n+1) specified by their two projections, and j_n:X_n → X. Let c_n be the specified canonical tensor-pullback composition comparisons and let (F_n,φ_n) be a coherent thickening system [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-systems-dictionary]. Let j:Z → X be a closed immersion whose kernel ideal annihilates every j_(n,*)F_n sectionwise. Then X is Noetherian and there is a coherent formal module M on (X,(ker(Spec(A/I) → Spec A)).comap f) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] supported on Z. For every coherent G on X and every isomorphism completion(G) ≅ M there are isomorphisms ψ_n:j_n^*G ≅ F_n satisfying i_n^*(ψ_(n+1)) ≫ φ_n = c_(n,G) ≫ ψ_n. Completeness of A, separatedness of f, and properness of Z are not assumed.

proof.text: Choose the tensor-pullback adjunctions using nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction from def-pc-module-pullback. Apply thickeningSystems_dictionary with i, hi, hp and these adjunctions. Retain Noetherianity of X, closedness and the kernel formulas, the functor Φ, evaluation isomorphisms β, restriction comparison d, restriction functor R, evaluation comparisons r, and the equivalence on isomorphisms supplied by the completion comparison.

At level zero, the dictionary kernel formula says ker(j_0) equals the extended ideal I O_X. The quotient spectrum map is a closed immersion because the quotient ring homomorphism is surjective. Mathlib Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion rewrites ker(j_0) as comap along f of the quotient spectrum kernel. Simplify I^1=I and rewrite the goal using this equality. No separate quotient-base-change ideal theorem is applied.

For each n, let t=d_n.symm followed by c_n, an automorphism of j_n^*. Closed-immersion pushforward supplies the invertible counit ε for the chosen adjunction. Form the identity-functor automorphism s=ε.symm followed by pushforward-whiskering of t followed by ε. Naturality of t against the adjunction unit and the left triangle identity identify s on j_n^*G with t on G; naturality of s therefore gives ψ followed by s_H.inv equals t_G.inv followed by ψ for every ψ:j_n^*G≅H. This is proved in the private helper extend_pullback_automorphism. Define the coherent thickening system S with terms F_n and comparison φ_n followed by s_(F_n).inv. Take M=Φ(S). The dictionary evaluation and transition identities specify M up to isomorphism, rather than choosing an unspecified formal object from bare existence.

For each formal term M_n, coherence implies quasi-coherence by coherent-ft-locnoeth. Cover X by all its affine opens. On U, the evaluation isomorphism β_n(S) maps a times t to a times its image, which is zero by hkill. Its map on sections is injective, so a times t=0 in M_n. The idealOfOpens equality on affine opens translates this to ker(j)(U) contained in Ann(M_n(U)). Apply idealPowerProduct_isZero_iff_affine_cover at exponent one, whose idealSheafPower is definitionally the original inclusion. Thus ker(j) M_n is zero for every n, exactly SupportedOn.

Given completion(G)≅M, invert the dictionary equivalence on isomorphisms to obtain e:R(G)≅S. Set ψ_n=r_n(G).symm followed by evaluation_n(e). The compatibility of e and the restriction comparison equation give i_n^*(ψ_(n+1)) followed by φ_n followed by s_(F_n).inv equals d_n(G) followed by ψ_n; the private restriction_iso_equation proves this by cancelling the pullback of r_(n+1)(G). Normalize the right side using ψ_n followed by s_(F_n).inv equals c_n(G).inv followed by d_n(G) followed by ψ_n. Cancel s_(F_n).inv and c_n(G).hom followed by c_n(G).inv to obtain precisely the required equation with c_n and the original φ_n. The private remove_normalization proves these cancellations. The argument works for any comparison c, so hc need not be used to identify arbitrary adjunction choices.

theorem supportedThickening_dictionary
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c n = (Classical.choice (Scheme.Modules.nonempty_tensorPullbackComp (i n)
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 +
      1)))))))).symm ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (hi n)))
    (F : ∀ n : ℕ, (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).Modules)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).obj (F (n + 1)) ≅ F n)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).toRingedSpace (F n))
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hkill : ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, V)),
        a ∈ j.ker.idealOfOpens V →
        ∀ t : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj (F n), V),
          a • t = 0) :
    ∃ hX : IsNoetherian X,
      ∃ M : @CoherentFormalModule X hX
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f),
        @SupportedOn X Z hX
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f) M j _ ∧
        ∀ G : CoherentModules X,
          Nonempty ((@completion X hX
            ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f)).obj G ≅ M) →
          ∃ ψ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G.obj ≅ F n,
            ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (ψ (n + 1)).hom ≫
              (φ n).hom = (c n).hom.app G.obj ≫ (ψ n).hom
